notes: s010 and s012 keep only *that*: the pronoun slot is filled by the expressed ἡμεῖς, and rule 90 gives the article the single relativizer while each participle keeps its verb and supplied copula. Reading them as attributive articles emptied under rule 31 remains defensible.
οὐ μή is kept whole as *in no wise* under rule 33, headed on *no*, with *shall* left to φθάσωμεν.
s017 takes *of the* headed on *the* under rules 17 and 21, while s015 takes a bare *the*.
